name: Nexus
description: Native channels (forge 26d-3): channels, private channels and direct conversations, their members, messages with mentions, files and threads, and reactions, with the unread counts and the tools agents use. A library app: Forge's Messaging app draws it, bridges and agents build on it.

commands.title: Add someone to a channel
commands.description: Adds a person (args.user, a user id) to the target channel as a member. Only a member adds people to a private channel; nobody is added to a direct conversation or an archived channel. Adding a member again changes nothing.

commands.title: Archive a channel
commands.description: Archives the target channel: it stays readable, but no one posts in it or joins it. Only its owner archives it.

commands.title: New channel
commands.description: Makes a channel, its target the new channel's id: its name (lower case, without #), topic, and whether it is private (seen only by its members; fixed once made). Its maker becomes its owner and first member, an admin.

commands.title: Join a channel
commands.description: Joins the target channel as a member, so its messages count as unread and posting is allowed. Only a channel that is not private or archived; joining again changes nothing.

commands.title: Leave a channel
commands.description: Leaves the target channel: the caller's membership ends, and with it, for a private channel, their access to it.

commands.title: Mark a channel read
commands.description: Marks the target channel read for the caller: args.count is the channel's message count they have seen (the unread query's count), so their unread count is the channel's count less it.

commands.title: Open a direct conversation
commands.description: Opens the direct conversation between the caller and args.user, its target dm-<lower id>-<higher id> (user ids compared as text), making it and both memberships the first time; opening it again changes nothing.

commands.title: Delete a message
commands.description: Deletes the target message: it keeps its place in the channel, with no text, mentions or files. Only its author deletes it.

commands.title: Edit a message
commands.description: Replaces the text of the target message. Only its author edits it, and not once it is deleted.

commands.title: Post a message
commands.description: Posts a message, its target the id the sender's browser made (so a message sent twice is one): in args.channel, Markdown text, the user ids it mentions, its files ({id, name, size, contentType}, uploaded as files of nexusMessage) and, in a thread, the message it replies to (parent). Only a member of the channel posts, and not in an archived one.

commands.title: React to a message
commands.description: Adds the emoji (args.emoji, the character) to the caller's reactions to the target message, or takes it away when they already reacted with it.

queries.name: channels
queries.description: The caller's channels and direct conversations, from their memberships ({channels: [{id, name, topic, kind, private, archived, peer, peerName, role, seen}]}), named channels by name, then direct conversations; with the unread query per channel for its counts.

queries.name: messages
queries.description: A channel's latest messages, newest first ({messages}, with each author expanded), or a thread's replies when parent is given, oldest first; limit 50 when left out. Pages show channels with a reversed mui.virtualList over nexusMessage instead. params {channel, parent?, limit?}.

queries.name: unread
queries.description: A channel's message count and its last message's time ({count, lastAt}, kept current), for a member's unread count (count less their membership's seen); nothing for a channel the caller cannot see. params {channel}.

projectors.name: unread
projectors.title: Channel counts
projectors.description: Each channel's message count and last message time, keyed by channel, for unread counts

roles.title: Nexus administrator
roles.description: Sees every channel, private ones too, with their members and messages, and changes them

roles.title: Nexus user
roles.description: Makes channels and direct conversations, joins channels that are not private, posts, edits and deletes their own messages and reacts; sees a private channel only once a member

rowRules.nexusMember: !(record.private ?? false) || principal.hasRole('member', record.channel) || string(record.user ?? '') == principal.user || string(record.owner ?? '') == principal.user

roles.title: Private channel member
roles.description: Granted on one private channel by the app to each of its members: sees the channel, its members, messages and reactions

triggers.title: A membership changed
triggers.description: Keeps private channels' access in step with their memberships, as the app: a new member of a private channel gets the member role on it when whoever added them is its owner or holds that role there; a member who leaves loses it.

triggers.title: A message was posted
triggers.description: Notifies the people a new message mentions, as the app, once per message and person (key nexus:<message>:mention): in a private channel only its members, and never its author. The notification links to the message.

tools.name: readChannel
tools.title: Read a channel
tools.description: A channel's latest messages as the caller sees them (nexus.readChannel): oldest first, each {id, author, text, at, parent, replies?}, at most limit (30 when left out), with the channel's name and topic. A channel the caller may not read gives an error.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search messages
tools.description: Searches the messages the caller may read for text (nexus.search), best first: each {id, channel, author, text, at}, at most limit (10 when left out).

tools.name: post
tools.title: Post a message
tools.description: Posts a message to a channel as the caller (nexus.message.post): Markdown text, optionally a reply in the thread of parent, mentioning the user ids in mentions. Gives the new message's id, or why it was refused (not a member, archived).

tools.name: react
tools.title: React to a message
tools.description: Toggles an emoji reaction (the character, such as 👍) on a message as the caller (nexus.reaction.toggle): added, or taken away when they had it.

ephemeral.title: Typing
ephemeral.description: Who is typing in a channel, keyed by the channel's id: sent by the composer at most every three seconds with {name}, never stored; read by whoever may see the channel
